# Finding ∫ log(x) dx

## Integration by Parts

I'll use integration by parts with the formula: ∫ u dv = u·v - ∫ v·du

Let:
- u = log(x)
- dv = dx

Then:
- du = (1/x)·dx
- v = x

## Applying the Formula

∫ log(x) dx = x·log(x) - ∫ x·(1/x)·dx

Simplifying the integrand:

∫ log(x) dx = x·log(x) - ∫ 1·dx

Evaluating the remaining integral:

∫ log(x) dx = x·log(x) - x + C

## Verification

Let's differentiate x·log(x) - x:

d/dx [x·log(x) - x] = 1·log(x) + x·(1/x) - 1 = log(x) + 1 - 1 = log(x) ✓

<answer>x*log(x) - x + C</answer>
